name: Faro de Moncloa

rights.note: Designed in 1990 as the lighting and communications tower of the City of Madrid (European Capital of Culture 1992); refurbished after 2009 (second exterior lift, wider stairs, visitor reception at the base).

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q386413_faro_de_moncloa.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. A cylindrical stainless-clad shaft (6 m, from OSM), not a lattice tower. +Z faces 175°: the side the D-shaped deck opens to and the side of the entrance porch and the stair-window slot. Deck plan from OSM: a 27.8 m circle centred 3.9 m south of the shaft, cut by a straight edge 1.1 m south of the shaft axis, a glazed block jutting north round the shaft, and the ring walkway closing the circle on the north, held by V struts. Heights partly measured on photos (±10 %): underside from 83.5 m, deck floor 92 m (published), gallery to 97.4 m, shaft cap 101 m, lattice mast to 110 m (OSM tags the deck at 104–110 m and the mast to 140 m; the published 110 m total and 92 m viewpoint were preferred). The lift guide frames (east and west) and cabins, the visitor reception at the base and the antennas are simplified; the LED screen is not modelled.
